title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2024 Rule of Law Report
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘and robust fact-checking mechanisms’ and ‘calls on the Commission and the Member States to monitor this and to apply the DSA and the Digital Markets Act swiftly, particularly regarding very large online platforms; calls on the Commission to include greater scrutiny of online platform disinformation in Pillar 3 (Pluralism and Media Freedom) of its rule of law report;’
